papers.title: ReflectPO: Reflection-Guided Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.summary: ReflectPO is an RL framework that helps LLM agents recover from early errors in long-horizon tasks. It combines Reflection-Guided Sampling, which turns branch differences in trajectories into recovery hints, with Tree-Structured Credit Assignment for action-level credit. It achieves the best average performance across two long-horizon tool-use benchmarks.

papers.title: Is Complex Agentic Memory Always Needed? Naive RAG Is Stronger Than We Thought
papers.summary: Shows that a naive RAG baseline (Raw-RAG: dense retrieval plus reranking over raw conversation history) ranks first among compared memory systems in six of seven settings on LoCoMo, LongMemEval, MEME and MemoryAgentBench. Evidence analysis explains why: higher coverage of necessary evidence offsets lower utilization, and preserving raw information matters. Establishes naive RAG as an essential baseline for agentic memory.
